items.title: Claude Code v2.1.299
items.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS environment variable: Claude gets the paths of @ file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all Added CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS to change
items.summaryZh: Claude Code发布v2.1.299版本更新，针对终端长对话引入了空闲压缩机制（idle compaction），当200K+ token对话空闲约54分钟时自动压缩，以避免一小时提示词缓存失效导致重算成本。此外新增禁用文件内容直接读取的环境变量、支持插件读取多媒体字节及会话身份，并改进了Agent视图与安全模式参数控制。

items.title: Discover AI: A Learning Guide - 51 hands-on labs for learning how AI actually works.
items.summary: This is an offline app with 51 hands-on labs for learning how AI actually works, from neurons to agents and more... **A bit of insight** - 51 labs in 6 groups, from the basics (what a neuron is, gradient descent) through attention, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, quantization, serving and more - Each lab has a short lesson beside it, readable in Plain or Standard mode - Some of it actually runs rather than just animating:

items.title: b11608
items.summary: server : escape the special tokens without std::regex ( #30243 ) The d1-omni and kev prompts escape " < |name|>" in the request text with std::regex_replace. libstdc++ recurses for each char of the name, so a state of " < |" and 30000 letters overflows the stack of the HTTP thread and llama-server dies with SIGSEGV. server_decision_escape_special_tokens() writes the same text with a loop. test-server-component compar
items.summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11608构建，针对llama-server中的特殊字符转义逻辑进行了重构。此前使用std::regex_replace处理长字符会导致libstdc++递归过深从而触发栈溢出（SIGSEGV），新版本改用循环逻辑修复了该服务崩溃缺陷。
